tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start recording audio from the default input device

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop the current recording and process it

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check if a recording is currently in progress

tools.name: list_processing_jobs
tools.description: List background processing jobs for recent recordings

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recent normal meetings and voice memos; restricted items are excluded unless an explicit logged override is enabled and requested

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search normal meeting transcripts and voice memos; restricted items are excluded unless an explicit logged override is enabled and requested

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get a normal meeting transcript; restricted meetings return a content-free stub unless an explicit logged override is enabled and requested

tools.name: activity_summary
tools.description: Summarize desktop context bound to one exact normal meeting source

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Search desktop-context events bound to one exact normal meeting source

tools.name: get_moment
tools.description: Show the local desktop-context rewind bound to one exact normal meeting source

tools.name: get_screen_context
tools.description: Retrieve bounded, verified screenshots bound to one exact normal meeting source

tools.name: process_audio
tools.description: On macOS and Linux, process bounded inbox or Downloads WAV audio; compressed/private containers and Windows fail closed without reading audio; retained library recordings are unavailable

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Add a timestamped note to the current active recording; existing meeting files are not mutable from this assistant tool

tools.name: consistency_report
tools.description: Flag conflicting decisions and stale commitments

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Build a profile from policy-authorized meetings within supported corpus bounds

tools.name: research_topic
tools.description: Research a topic across policy-authorized meetings within supported corpus bounds

tools.name: start_dictation
tools.description: Start dictation mode — speech to clipboard and daily notes

tools.name: stop_dictation
tools.description: Stop dictation mode

tools.name: track_commitments
tools.description: List open and stale commitments, optionally filtered by person

tools.name: relationship_map
tools.description: Rank relationships from the bounded process-private policy-safe graph projection

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List enrolled voice profiles for speaker identification

tools.name: confirm_speaker
tools.description: Compatibility name only: agent-controlled speaker mutation is unavailable; use the Minutes app or human CLI

tools.name: get_meeting_insights
tools.description: Query decisions, commitments, and questions extracted from meetings; each insight records a path to its source meeting, that path is resolved to a meeting in the live corpus and the resolved meeting is re-verified against live sensitivity policy before release, and withheld records are reported as a partial view

tools.name: start_live_transcript
tools.description: Start a live transcript session for real-time meeting transcription

tools.name: read_live_transcript
tools.description: Read utterances from the active live transcript with optional cursor or time window

tools.name: start_copilot
tools.description: Start the independent real-time copilot for a goal and observe its CLI nudge stream

tools.name: stop_copilot
tools.description: Stop the active real-time copilot without changing recording or live transcription

tools.name: copilot_status
tools.description: Read current copilot session and provider health from the CLI status surface

tools.name: read_copilot_nudges
tools.description: Read observed copilot nudges incrementally by cursor or time window

tools.name: ingest_meeting
tools.description: Extract facts from a meeting and update the knowledge base (person profiles, log, index)

tools.name: resummarize_meeting
tools.description: Re-run the AI pass on an edited meeting or memo, previewing by default and preserving user edits

tools.name: knowledge_status
tools.description: Show the current state of the knowledge base — configuration, adapter, people count, log entries

tools.name: add_agent_annotation
tools.description: Append attributed agent commentary as an agent.annotation event, never editing meeting markdown or frontmatter (allowlist-gated by ~/.minutes/agents.allow)

tools.name: get_agent_annotations
tools.description: Compatibility name only: unavailable because an annotation's source pointer and body are both author-supplied, so revalidating the pointer cannot bound what the body discloses

resources.name: Minutes Dashboard
resources.description: Interactive meeting dashboard and detail viewer

resources.name: recent_meetings
resources.description: List of recent meetings and memos

resources.name: open_actions
resources.description: All open action items across meetings

resources.name: recent_events
resources.description: Recent pipeline events with meeting-derived content withheld until source policy provenance is available

resources.name: agent_annotations
resources.description: Agent annotations are withheld until their source policy provenance can be revalidated

resources.name: live_events
resources.description: Live events are currently withheld because raw cursors can reveal restricted activity; reads return a constant unavailable response.

resources.name: live_copilot
resources.description: Current copilot state and latest observed nudge. Subscribe for notifications/resources/updated or poll this URI; MCP only controls and observes the independent minutes copilot engine.

resources.name: recent-ideas
resources.description: Recent voice memos and ideas captured from any device (last 14 days)

resources.name: live_events_since_seq
resources.description: Live event cursor reads are currently withheld because raw cursors can reveal restricted activity; reads return a constant unavailable response.

resources.name: meeting
resources.description: Get a specific meeting by its filename slug

prompts.name: meeting_prep
prompts.text: Search my past meetings about ${arguments.meeting_topic}. Find relevant decisions, open action items, and context I should review before the meeting.

prompts.name: weekly_review
prompts.text: List my meetings from the past week and summarize key decisions, action items, and commitments. Flag anything overdue.

prompts.name: find_action_items
prompts.description: Find action items assigned to someone
prompts.text: Search for all open action items assigned to ${arguments.person}. Show what was committed, when, and in which meeting.

prompts.name: person_briefing
prompts.description: Get a briefing on a person before a meeting
prompts.text: Build a profile for ${arguments.name} from policy-authorized meetings within supported corpus bounds. What topics do we discuss? What commitments are open? What decisions have we made together?

prompts.name: topic_research
prompts.description: Research a topic across policy-authorized meetings within supported corpus bounds
prompts.text: Research ${arguments.topic} across policy-authorized meetings within supported corpus bounds. Show related decisions, open follow-ups, and which meetings discussed it most.

prompts.name: start_meeting
prompts.text: Start recording a meeting titled '${arguments.title}'. I'll transcribe it locally when we're done.
